snippet.title: ELDERBORN: VENGEANCE  - Reveal Trailer
snippet.description:
The Heavy Metal FPP Slasher is back!

ELDERBORN: VENGEANCE is a brutal spin-off with faster, nastier first-person melee combat, deeper weapon mastery, build-shaping progression, a new hook, and glorious FINISHERS.

Set in the ancient world before ours, this is a blood-soaked tale of vengeance, crushed bones, and forgotten gods - where someone close to you is taken, and the only answer left is violence.

Wishlist NOW!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3815480/ELDERBORN_VENGEANCE/
